port_test.environment: Linux with a readable /proc table for its own processes, Python 3, Verilator with --binary --timing --assert, C++ and make. VERILATOR may name its executable.
port_test.result: PASS requires 1,224 observations, zero mismatches and normal completion before the stock 38-program CPU regression. The fixed bench builds and runs with the reference module, so a build failure, an abnormal end, a missing or incomplete observation record and an explicit mismatch are FAIL (1). Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID (2).
